protocol: per-user holdout 2 positives (rating>=4), seed=42, train-only fit+history
notes: Sparse single-category catalogue (1000 appliances, 664 reviews, 150 review users). Random per-user holdout of 2 positives. Top-10 retrieval of exact held-out items is hard; model shows ~2x random signal at K=50. LTR marginally above baseline at K=10 (2/60 users).
